Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one inventory accessory icon for a classic pixel-art JRPG.
Primary request: a strong polished silver ring seen at a three-quarter angle, thick faceted metal band and a small deep red square ruby setting. A ring of strength, compact bold silhouette.
Style: beautiful highly readable handcrafted 32x32 logical-pixel inventory sprite, enlarged as crisp nearest-neighbor square pixel blocks, detailed 16-bit/early PlayStation RPG style, strong dark contours and carefully placed metallic highlights, limited palette.
